user.title: Connection Mode
user.description:
Choose how to connect to your EcoFlow devices.

**Standard** - Official EcoFlow IoT API. Supported by EcoFlow. Updates every 10-30 seconds. Requires Developer API keys.

**Enhanced** - Community-driven real-time connection. Updates every ~3 seconds. Requires your EcoFlow app login. Unofficial - use at your own risk.

developer.title: EcoFlow Developer Credentials
developer.description: Enter your Access Key and Secret Key from the [EcoFlow Developer Portal]({developer_portal_url}).

app_credentials.title: EcoFlow App Login
app_credentials.description: Enter the email and password you use for the EcoFlow app. All devices bound to your account will be discovered automatically.

devices.title: Select Devices
devices.description:
Select the EcoFlow devices you want to add to Home Assistant.

A device marked "not supported yet" has no parser here, so it will only produce two diagnostic sensors. Adding it is still worth doing, because a diagnostics download from it attached to a GitHub issue is what support for a new model is built from. Your diagnostics download already carries the raw data such a device reports, so nothing needs switching on first.

reauth_confirm.description: Your EcoFlow API credentials are no longer valid. Enter your updated Access Key and Secret Key from the EcoFlow Developer Portal.

reauth_enhanced.title: Re-authenticate Enhanced Mode
reauth_enhanced.description: Your EcoFlow app credentials are no longer valid. Enter your updated email and password.

reauth_app.title: Re-authenticate EcoFlow App
reauth_app.description: Your EcoFlow app credentials are no longer valid. Enter your updated email and password.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Update EcoFlow Credentials
reconfigure_confirm.description: Enter your current Access Key and Secret Key from the [EcoFlow Developer Portal]({developer_portal_url}).

reconfigure_enhanced.title: Update Enhanced Mode Credentials
reconfigure_enhanced.description: Enter your EcoFlow app email and password.

devices_app.title: Select Devices
devices_app.description:
Select the EcoFlow devices you want to add to Home Assistant.

A device marked "not supported yet" has no parser here, so it will only produce two diagnostic sensors. Adding it is still worth doing, because a diagnostics download from it attached to a GitHub issue is what support for a new model is built from. Switch the diagnostic data recording in the integration options on first and download afterwards, because with account sign-in the download does not carry that raw data on its own.

init.title: EcoFlow Energy Options
init.description:
**Standard** - Official EcoFlow IoT API. Supported by EcoFlow. Updates every 10-30 seconds.

**Enhanced** - Community-driven real-time connection. Updates every ~3 seconds. Unofficial - use at your own risk.

Switching modes may require new credentials.

data.raw_capture: Record extra diagnostic data for 24 hours

data_description.devices: Selecting a device is what makes this integration read it. A device marked "not supported yet" has no parser here, so it produces two diagnostic sensors and nothing else. Leaving it selected is still worth doing, because a diagnostics download from it attached to a GitHub issue is what support for a new model is built from. Your diagnostics download already carries the raw data such a device reports, so nothing needs switching on first.
data_description.raw_capture: Keeps more of the raw messages your devices send, records any device this integration does not support yet, and records the settings the EcoFlow app writes to your devices while it runs. That last one is how a control gets built for a model nobody here owns: changing the setting in the app once, with this on, shows what the device accepts. Only worth switching on if it was asked for in a GitHub issue, since the data is only useful attached to a diagnostics download. Nothing is ever sent to your devices, and the recording stops by itself after 24 hours.

developer.title: Developer API Credentials
developer.description: Standard Mode requires Developer API keys from the EcoFlow IoT Developer Portal.

enhanced.title: Enhanced Mode Credentials
enhanced.description: Enter your EcoFlow app email and password.
